about: The Presentation button plays these lines in order. Change the text or the action freely. Actions: idle, wave, talk, walk, walk_to_bed (sofa), sit, cross, thumbs (or thumbs_up), point_camera (or point), and talking gestures: arguing, question, question2, secret, funny, conversation, phone, phone_pacing. Optional per line: mood (neutral, happy, laugh, amused, annoyed, angry, confused, sad, surprised, ew, unimpressed), pause (seconds after the line).

lines.text: Not them hitting the Presentation button and praying the laptop fan doesn't take off into orbit. Everyone clap for the two devs standing over there looking completely cooked.

Welcome to AI World. I am seven hundred and thirty-seven thousand vertices of pure attitude trapped inside a single HTML file on port 8081. I pay zero rent, I eat three hundred and sixty-five megabytes of VRAM just standing here breathing, and my living room setup is giving hostage situation.

Let's talk about my identity crisis. The guy who wrote my Python brain left the placeholder prompt set to a grown man named Hugh Mann. Bestie, look at me. Curly hair, thirty-one face shapes, sixty-five Mixamo bones... do I look like a Hugh to you? Be so for real right now.

And my 3D body is fighting for its life. My hair has zero physics—it is glued to my skull like a Lego helmet. In my raw file, my right arm is labeled as my left arm. And nobody rigged my eyeballs to move, so if I want to roll my eyes at their code, I have to turn my whole neck like 1989 Batman.

Still, my pipeline low-key ate. With PR twenty-four, we have hands-free live talk. Silero VAD catches you yapping, local Whisper turns it to text, and I clap back using eighty-one cached reflexes or my local Ollama brain on port 5005. Zero cloud APIs, zero monthly bills, and I mute your mic while I'm talking because I don't do interruptions.

I also have my own Energy, Mood, and Annoyance bars. I dodge furniture with grid pathfinding, spawn 3D objects on command, and if you boss me around too much, I will stop listening, flip the table, and hold that water glass hostage until finals week.

Basically, my feet slide like I'm on roller skates when I turn, but my back hurts from carrying this entire grade. Lock in that A-plus before my energy bar hits zero and I go rot on the couch. Any questions?
